game_title: Off By One Autopsy – Oasis Pool Defense
game_concept: A action defense set in Sand Dunes – Oasis Pool, a blue oasis pool: the caravan guide must handle giant scorpions while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Off By One Autopsy: Diagnose off-by-one failures in loops and indexes in a broken script.
theme: Sand Dunes – Oasis Pool: a blue oasis pool
core_gameplay_loop: In Oasis Pool, repeat each round: Diagnose off-by-one failures in loops and indexes in a broken script. Each round, giant scorpions strike the temple door, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the autopsy value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Protect the temple door from giant scorpions in Oasis Pool: keep the autopsy meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 29-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: autopsy drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 29-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 3 (intro tier): Off By One Autopsy
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Off By One Autopsy' (Week 9 slot 6), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Oasis Pool'. region.name: Sand Dunes

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how autopsy changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against giant scorpions in Oasis Pool.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 29 seconds while autopsy > 0.
